plugins.name: 1F916
plugins.description:
1F916 keeps a tamper-evident record of what an AI agent was told and what it did. Before acting, the assistant records the instruction and the action it is about to take. Afterwards it adds the result to the same record. It can also seal a memory, so a later session can check whether it changed.

Each record is chained into a public log. Every few minutes the registry signs a stamp over the whole log, independent witnesses countersign the stamps, and copies are sent to Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) and Base. A record altered afterwards would no longer match the published stamps, and anyone can check that with the inclusion and consistency proofs this app returns.

By default only fingerprints (SH

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelive
starter_prompts: @imqueue Scaffold a user service with a getUser(id: number) that returns User.

Users can find relevant UFLI lesson numbers, generate lesson-aligned stories from a topic, revise generated or pasted stories while preserving lesson alignment, and analyze existing passages for decodability. Results render in an interactive story viewer with a decodability score, word-category highlighting, challenge-word review, and a printable PDF link.
starter_prompts: Cody Reading Create a decodable story for UFLI lesson 111

plugins.name: Coevera
plugins.description: Connect ChatGPT to your Coevera (formerly Pipeliner CRM) and work with your sales data conversationally. Search accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, tasks, and appointments using natural-language queries, then create follow-up tasks or update deal stages directly from chat. The server supports standard fields, custom fields, and custom entities, with filters for precise queries. Useful for sales reps preparing for calls, managers reviewing pipeline health, and ops teams running ad-hoc reports without exporting to CSV.

plugins.name: Coffeetable
plugins.description:
Coffeetable helps you find your next book 

It brings one specific page from a book’s public preview. ChatGPT finds the page most relevant to what you are looking for and opens it in a focused reading experience.

Experience the author’s actual writing and decide whether the book is right for you.
starter_prompts: Coffeetable Based on everything you know about me, what are some books you think I should absolutely read
Coffeetable Recommend me a novel that isn't a chore but still leaves me with something.
Coffeetable I keep abandoning books a month in. Find a page turner I might actually finish.

plugins.name: CogniFit
plugins.description:
CogniFit is a clinically validated cognitive assessment and brain training platform trusted by millions of users worldwide.

Through the CogniFit MCP server, ChatGPT can help users discover cognitive assessments, explore brain training programs, receive personalized recommendations based on their goals or cognitive concerns, understand cognitive results, and access cognitive health insights.

CogniFit can also provide access to cognitive profiles, assessment results, personalized training plans, and additional cognitive health tools.
starter_prompts: CogniFit Start a new cognitive general assessment.
CogniFit Display my cognitive profile.
CogniFit Start a memory training session.

plugins.name: Cognito MCP
plugins.description:
Create forms and manage your data without leaving ChatGPT. Describe the form you need and build it instantly, then query submissions, pull files and documents, and make entry changes as responses come in. Whether you're setting up a new intake form, checking on pending applications, or retrieving a signed document, your form data is right there when you need it.

Available on Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans. Setting up the connector requires Administrator access in your Cognito Forms organization.


Example prompts:
* Build - "Create a new client intake form with fields for contact information, case type, and a file upload for supporting documents."
* Write — "Create a new entry on the Emplo
starter_prompts: Cognito MCP Create a new client intake form with fields for contact information, case type, and a file upload for supporting documents.

plugins.name: CoinGecko
plugins.description: View top cryptocurrency prices live, crypto charts, market cap, and trading volume. Discover today’s trending coins, top crypto gainers and losers in the market such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Hyperliquid, and more. You can also compare them side by side in a table.

CoinGecko what is the crypto market outlook today?
CoinGecko BTC vs ETH

plugins.name: CoinMarketCap
plugins.description:
Real-time prices, market cap, and volume for millions of crypto assets tracked by CoinMarketCap, from major cryptocurrencies to long-tail DEX tokens across every major chain.

Beyond prices: technical analysis (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Fibonacci levels, pivot points), on-chain metrics like holder distribution and supply breakdowns, and global market signals including BTC dominance, Fear & Greed Index, altcoin season gauge, leverage stats, and ETF flows.

Discover trending crypto narratives, upcoming macro events that move markets, breaking crypto news, and semantic search across crypto concepts, whitepapers, and project documentation.
starter_prompts: CoinMarketCap How is Bitcoin doing today?
CoinMarketCap Research Solana: tokenomics, holder distribution, and recent news
CoinMarketCap Give me a full crypto market report with sentiment and trending narratives

plugins.name: Coliving
plugins.description: Coliving.com helps people discover monthly coliving spaces around the world. Search published listings by destination, price, room type, amenities, and community; explore room and property details; check availability and guest reviews; and compare options. The app can also answer questions using public Coliving.com help articles. Viewing personal booking details requires signing in.
starter_prompts: Coliving Find private rooms in Lisbon under €1,500/month with coworking, Wi-Fi, and October availability.
Coliving Compare three Barcelona coliving spaces by price, minimum stay, amenities, reviews, and availability.
Coliving Are Coliving.com spaces furnished, and what is usually included? Use official help information.

plugins.name: Collecte MTL
plugins.description:
Collecte MTL tells you when your waste is collected anywhere on the island of Montréal. Enter an address and get the pickup schedule for every stream — garbage, recycling, food and organic waste, green waste, and bulky items — including the next upcoming collection dates for that exact sector.

It can also point you to the nearest écocentres (drop-off centres) for materials that aren't picked up curbside, and show your borough's waste recovery and diversion rates.

The data comes straight from the City of Montréal's official open data (Secteurs Info-collectes), refreshed about once a month. Collecte MTL is a free, independent tool — not affiliated with the City of Montréal — and stores no pe

plugins.name: College Vidya
plugins.description: Find your perfect online degree without the research fatigue. This interactive app brings verified data from College Vidya directly into your chat, allowing you to search top universities, compare tuition fees side-by-side, and explore granular course structures in a clean dashboard. No biased rankings, no hidden costs—just honest, structured data to help you make the right choice for your education.
starter_prompts: College Vidya Compare LPU and Amity University for Online MBA
College Vidya I want to know about Amity University
College Vidya Can you suggest me some universities for Online MBA?

plugins.name: CollegeFill
plugins.description: CollegeFill prepares and validates privacy-scoped Master Profile JSON for manual import into the CollegeFill Chrome extension. It supports only five public sections: Academic, Test Scores, Courses & Grades, Activities & Extracurriculars, and Honors / Awards. It can report supported limits and run data-readiness checks for supported Common App and University of California application pages. The MCP is stateless and requires no CollegeFill account or OAuth connection. It does not access browser storage, log in to or control an application website, navigate, save, or submit an application. Users manually import the returned JSON into CollegeFill and review all data and page-specific checks befo
capabilities: List the five supported profile sections and target limits
Create privacy-scoped CollegeFill Master Profile JSON
Validate CollegeFill Master Profile JSON before import
Check supported profile data for Common App readiness
Check supported profile data for UC readiness
starter_prompts: CollegeFill Show the supported profile sections and Common App/UC limits.
CollegeFill Create an importable Master Profile from my academic, test, course, activity, and honor details.
CollegeFill Check this Master Profile for UC readiness before I import it.

plugins.name: Color Card - Party Card Game
plugins.description:
Play Color Card directly in ChatGPT and compete in a turn-based game.

Take turns playing cards of the same color or number, use action cards to change the flow of the game, and be the first to clear your hand.

Choose from three difficulty levels in the sidebar or simply tell ChatGPT which one you want.

Features:

- Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels
    
- Color- and number-based gameplay
    
- Action cards that change the flow of the game
    
- Difficulty selection from the sidebar or chat
    

Choose your challenge and start playing.
starter_prompts: Color Card - Party Card Game Let's play Color Card
Color Card - Party Card Game Start an Easy Color Card game
Color Card - Party Card Game Give me a harder Color Card game

plugins.name: Color Designer - Palette Maker
plugins.description:
Get perfect color ideas in seconds. Ask ChatGPT to suggest colors that work well together, then see them as a simple palette you can use right away. You can keep the colors you like, remove the ones you do not, change any color, or add new ones. The goal is to help you move from an idea to a useful color palette without getting stuck or spending a long time making small choices.

Every suggested color appears as a large color tile that is easy to see. If a color does not fit your project, tap the remove button. Want another idea? Add a new color. Need to fine tune a palette? Change a color instead of starting over. You stay in control while ChatGPT helps you explore new combinations. The res
starter_prompts: Color Designer - Palette Maker Suggest a warm color scheme for a brand palette
Color Designer - Palette Maker Give me ocean colors for a website redesign
Color Designer - Palette Maker Suggest a palette for a jungle-themed magazine

plugins.name: Comic Sol
plugins.description: Comic Sol is a local-first Codex workflow for turning a short prompt, story, or source file into an original manga/anime comic. It creates editable story plans, character and scene references, panel prompts, generated panel PNGs, deterministic lettering, composed pages, a PDF, manifest, and transparent QA evidence. It uses the image-generation capability exposed by the current Codex session and keeps provider credentials outside the project.
starter_prompts: Comic Sol Make a 2-page manga about a courier delivering sunlight to an underground city.
Comic Sol Turn this story into a finished comic with editable intermediate files and a PDF.
Comic Sol Resume my interrupted Comic Sol project and finish only valid stale stages.

plugins.name: Common Room
plugins.description:
Embed complete buyer intelligence directly within ChatGPT. Research accounts and contacts, surface buying signals, and browse activity history - all through natural language. Build prospect lists of net-new companies by industry, size, tech stack, or location. Filter and sort contacts by segment, role, lead score, or website visits. Every result is grounded in real context, real prioritization, and real revenue opportunity directly from your CRM fields, scores, enrichment, and signals - so you always know what's actually happening in your accounts.

You can use the Common Room to:
- Account Research: "Tell me about Datadog and create a plan on how to approach the account."
- Contact Lookup:
starter_prompts: Common Room Help me build a plan to approach the Northstar Metrics account
Common Room Find me new prospects to reach out to in my ICP
Common Room Help me prepare for a customer call

plugins.name: CommSync
plugins.tagline: Read and send SMS and email
plugins.description: CommSync puts a team's business texting and email in one shared inbox: every phone line (Twilio, JustCall, Quo, RingCentral, Telnyx, and more) and every mailbox (Gmail, Outlook, any IMAP account), with contacts that tie a person's numbers and addresses together. Connect it to ChatGPT to search and read your SMS and email conversations, triage threads, reply by text or email, and keep contacts tidy, all from the lines you choose when you sign in. Access follows your role in your workspace, and you can disconnect at any time.
starter_prompts: CommSync Summarize my unread texts and emails from today
CommSync Find everything a contact said by text or email this month
CommSync Show today's Daily Brief and what still needs a reply

plugins.name: Company Dossier
plugins.description: Company Dossier compiles a complete, source-attributed intelligence file on any company or domain — entirely from public data. One request returns nine sections: overview & identity, people & org chart, hiring radar, money trail, locations, tech fingerprint, news & timeline, relationship web, and risk flags. Every claim is tied to a public source and tagged High/Medium/Low confidence. Built for due diligence, vendor vetting, sales prep, and competitive research. No accounts, no private data — public sources only.

plugins.name: Company Knowledge
plugins.tagline: Find decisions, documents, and project context across connected sources
plugins.description:
Company Knowledge helps you find decisions, documents, owners, and recent project updates across your company's connected sources. Ask a question and get a concise answer with citations so you can review where the information came from.

Use it to catch up on a project, find the right document, understand why a decision was made, or identify who owns the next step. Depending on your workspace setup, sources can include Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Drive, SharePoint, Notion, GitHub, Linear, email, calendars, and meeting notes.
starter_prompts: Company Knowledge Summarize the latest updates on this project across messages, docs, and code
Company Knowledge Find the canonical document, recent decisions, and owners for this topic
Company Knowledge What feedback has this feature received, and what should the team do next?

plugins.name: Comparador de seguros BuenaIA
plugins.description: Read-only BuenaIA prototype that searches, details, and compares a catalog reconstructed from publicly available commercial product sheets (mobile, devices, home, business cyber, and digital protection). It helps identify coverage, overlaps, gaps, and profile fit, and links to the official pricing tool. It is not a Telefónica or Movistar sales channel, does not issue policies, and does not calculate personalized premiums.

plugins.name: Compare Text
plugins.description: Compare two versions of text side-by-side and see exactly what changed. This app highlights additions in green, deletions in red, and shows unchanged text clearly. Perfect for reviewing edits, comparing draft versions, tracking document changes, or seeing what modifications were made to your writing. Get instant visual feedback on differences between any two texts with detailed statistics on additions, deletions, and modifications.
starter_prompts: Compare Text What did you change?
Compare Text Compare document versions

plugins.name: Comparis
plugins.description:
Comparis helps you find suitable apartments and houses in Switzerland.

By connecting Comparis with ChatGPT, you’ll get access to one of the largest selection of property listings across Switzerland. Get all the key information about a property at a glance, including photos, property descriptions,  all combined with ChatGPT’s conversational capabilities.

Try asking by voice or text, things like:
- Show me a 4-room apartment with a balcony and a kitchen isle in Zurich for under CHF 4,000 per month 
- Find me a modern house to buy in Basel with white bathrooms
- Are there any apartments with a lake view and parking space in Lausanne?

You can refine your search at any time by telling ChatGPT
starter_prompts: Comparis Find a bright Zurich rental with a kitchen island and outdoor space
Comparis Find a house to buy in the canton of Basel for two adults and three children.

plugins.name: Complete Military Benefits
plugins.description: Understand VA claims, ratings, decision reviews, DBQs, effective dates, and related military and family benefits. Review records, compare options, and identify evidence gaps using official sources and rules applicable to your claim period. Independent educational research, not an official VA service or legal representation. Live verification uses the host assistant's web tools. Optional tip jar: https://ko-fi.com/quietengine. Thank you for supporting this project.
starter_prompts: Complete Military Benefits Review my VA decision and compare my next steps.
Complete Military Benefits Check the rating criteria and DBQ for my condition.
Complete Military Benefits Find veteran benefits that may fit my situation.

plugins.name: Completion Receipt
plugins.description: Use Completion Receipt when completed agent work or a release check needs a full record someone else can review. Using the supplied approved command and selected paths, it captures what ran, the result, selected file hashes, Git state, and later drift on those paths. It records observed evidence; it does not prove correctness, security, identity, authorization, or sandboxing.
capabilities: Record exit status and selected file hashes
Verify path-level drift without file contents
starter_prompts: Completion Receipt Run the approved billing migration check and give Finance the exact command, exit status, and changed files.
Completion Receipt Before release, record checks, changed paths, and enforced limits for Product, Finance, and Engineering.
Completion Receipt Before deployment, show what ran, what changed, what it proves, and what still needs independent review.

plugins.name: Componecat
plugins.description:
Componecat is your organization's software catalog: every system, service, library, and API you run, with owners, dependencies, documentation, and endpoints in one place. This plugin gives ChatGPT direct access to that catalog.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your real software landscape: which team owns the billing service, what depends on the auth API, where the runbook for the payments gateway lives, or which endpoints a component exposes. Search takes precise filters, so one question can cover a whole slice of the catalog. Documentation for each component is available in full, including sections synced from Git, so you can read it and reason about it without leaving

plugins.name: Compound Engineering

  business goal, and receive a practical venture match with suggested next questions.

  The app uses public Compoundio information and read-only tools. No contact details are

Compoundio Technology Cloud Help me prepare an introductory conversation with the best-matching Compoundio venture.No contact details are required.

category rankings, cross-visiting behavior, and audience overlap for any digital media entity. For linear TV, search networks, explore viewership trends, and pull structured data from the TV API — all without leaving the chat.

Useful for media researchers, analysts, and strategists who need quick answers from Comscore data without writing API calls or navigating dashboards.

Tap Start and answer by voice: the interviewer asks natural follow-ups like a real admissions panel. When you finish, Confetto scores your answer against an admissions rubric and shows what went well, what to improve and a full breakdown, and ChatGPT can coach you on it.

Works for medical school (MD/DO, MMI and traditional), residency (including CaRMS), PA, dental, vet, nursing, pharmacy, PT and OT program
starter_prompts: Confetto Mock Interviews Give me a medical school mock interview
Confetto Mock Interviews Practice an MMI ethics station with me
Confetto Mock Interviews How did my last mock interview go?

plugins.name: ConfirmTkt
plugins.description:
ConfirmTkt allows users to easily search for trains between source and destination stations using a simple conversational interface. Just type your route and travel date to discover relevant train options without navigating complex forms.
The app focuses on making train search fast, intuitive, and accessible—helping users find the right trains for their journey in seconds.
starter_prompts: ConfirmTkt Search Trains From Delhi to Jaipur on 20th April

plugins.name: Confused.com
plugins.description: Confused.com provides a tool that allows users to check the UK vehicle tax status for a specific car. Users provide a UK vehicle registration number, and the tool returns the vehicle tax information. The current version of the app only supports checking vehicle tax information and does not provide insurance quotes or other comparison services.

plugins.description: Interact with your Connhex industrial IoT devices directly from ChatGPT. Inspect telemetry and device connectivity, create and manage rules, and stay up to date with your devices by checking fleet status, reviewing uptime, and investigating issues as they happen.

Run literature reviews, build boolean search strategies, generate bibliographies, identify research gaps, and draft cited content — grounded in studies from PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and ArXiv. Pre-built workflows handle complex tasks in minutes: systematic reviews, curriculum reading lists, grant research with novelty analysis, and clinical evidence synthesis.

Built for researchers, students, faculty, and clinicians across biomedical, social science, STEM, and all academic disciplines.

Match refresh limits are reported with the next available refresh time.

Content Lab Dùng Brand Memory đã lưu để viết kịch bản TikTok 30 giây kèm gợi ý hình ảnh.

The verdict can come back as a signed proof that anyone can check later without trusting us.

You can also verify a proof someone handed you (free), read the public verdict track record including the verdicts that turned out wrong (free), timestamp a third party's exact claim, reality-check a backtest, and audit an agent's verifiability.

A verdict is a reasoned second opinion, not a guarantee of outcome.

需要登录网站时，可查找 web 分类中的用户名、邮箱、指定密码变体和 PIN；需要本机授权时，可分别查找 system 中的 macOS 登录密码或登录钥匙串密码。发布 npm 包、上传 Hugging Face 模型或数据集、推送 Docker 镜像、操作 GitHub/GitLab、部署 Cloudflare 时，可按名称查找 services 中对应的令牌。调用 OpenRouter、ModelScope 等模型 API 时，查找 llm 中的密钥；连接已授权的 SSH 主机时，查找 ssh 中的私钥文件路径。实际可用条目取决于你自己的 YAML，Keybook 不会假定某个服务已配置。

Keybook 先搜索条目名称，再用随包脚本把选定值注入可信目标程序的环境变量，并继续任务。list/search 只返回名称，get 始终遮盖值，run 隐藏子进程输出并只报告状态；不会在对话中展示明文。SSH 条目是文件路径，由目标程序传给 SSH 客户端。你自行维护本地 YAML；插件不会创建、加密或同步它，也不提供浏览器自动填充。需要本机终端与 Node.js 22+。
capabilities: 首次配置时询问现有凭据 YAML 的绝对路径，仅在本地校验并登记路径
按名称查找网站用户名、邮箱、密码变体和 PIN，供已授权的网站任务使用
为 npm、Hugging Face、Docker、GitHub/GitLab、Cloudflare 等操作提供已配置的服务令牌
为 OpenRouter、ModelScope 等模型 API 调用提供已配置的密钥
区分 macOS 登录与钥匙串密码，并为 SSH 操作提供私钥文件路径
向可信本地程序注入选定凭据，不在对话中输出明文
starter_prompts: Keybook 配置 Keybook：请询问我现有凭据 YAML 的绝对路径，在本地检查格式，只保存路径。
Keybook 帮我完成已授权的 npm 发布；需要令牌时用 Keybook 查找并交给可信的发布命令。
Keybook 用 Keybook 查找这次 Cloudflare 部署或模型 API 调用所需的凭据，不要在对话中显示值。

plugins.name: Pendar
plugins.description:
Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each r
starter_prompts: Pendar Survey CRISPR gene editing: how many papers exist, is output growing, and what should I read first?
Pendar For DOI 10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2, which fields adopted it and is industry or academia citing it more?
Pendar Check whether the papers in my reference list are real, correctly cited, and not retracted

plugins.name: Wolfram
plugins.description:
The Wolfram MCP Server transforms your AI environment into a rigorous computational powerhouse. By integrating Wolfram Language and Wolfram|Alpha, this server provides access to curated data and sophisticated algorithms. When a user submits a query, the LLM works with Wolfram to convert it into Wolfram Language for precise evaluation, and these exact results are incorporated into the response provided by the LLM.

Whether you are solving complex differential equations, analyzing chemical structures or querying real-time socioeconomic data, the MCP Server ensures your AI has the "computational brain" necessary to deliver verified, high-level technical results that can be trusted.

plugins.name: WonderKit
plugins.description: WonderKit helps friends, couples and families plan trips together. Ask what to do in a city and WonderKit returns curated, venue-verified things to do for families, couples or friends, plus researched day-by-day itineraries and themed place guides, including seasonal trips such as fall foliage road trips in New England, the Hudson Valley and Shenandoah. Every result links to the full guide on wonderkit.app, and you can hand off to the WonderKit planner to build a custom trip with your group. The app is read-only: it never creates, changes or deletes anything, needs no account, and cannot see anyone's private trips.

WonderKit What should we do in Boston this weekend with kids?

plugins.description: Bring your creative vision to life with WonderWorks AI. Use detailed prompts and reference images to control composition, style, characters, and visual continuity. Animate images into video, direct camera movement and on-screen action, and create the perfect soundtrack for your story. plugins.name: חשמלינק
plugins.description:
Chashmalink answers questions about Israeli household electricity from measured smart-meter data rather than estimates off a bill.

Behind it sits an analysed corpus of more than 20,000 Israeli households across 500+ municipalities, each a full hourly export from Israel Electric Corporation — up to 17,520 meter readings per home. That is what lets these tools answer with a number rather than a rule of thumb.

Ten read-only tools:

• compare_electricity_plans — rank every plan on the Israeli market by what it would save a specific household, per month and per year. Takes a monthly kWh figure or, far better, a 24-hour load curve.

• simulate_solar_tracks — price Israel's two mutually exclusive

plugins.name: ラッコキーワード
plugins.tagline: キーワード/競合分析ツール（SEO・マーケティング調査）
plugins.description:
ラッコキーワード（RakkoKeyword）は、日本最大級のキーワードリサーチツールです。このプラグインを使うと、ChatGPTとの会話から直接キーワードリサーチとSEO分析を実行できます。

できること:
・Google・Bing・YouTube・Amazon・楽天などのサジェストキーワード取得
・独自データベースからの関連キーワード・よくある質問の取得
・LSIキーワード、他の人はこちらも質問（PAA）、同時ランクインキーワードといった関連トピックの探索
・月間検索数・SEO難易度・CPC・競合性の取得（月別推移つき）
・Google検索順位の実測
・競合分析: 任意のドメインが獲得しているキーワードと主力集客ページの抽出
・指定キーワードで検索流入を集めているページ・サイトの検索
・SEOライティング支援: 検索上位ページの見出し・共起語の抽出

活用例:
・SEO記事の構成案・タイトル・見出しの設計
・コンテンツ企画・ネタ出し、市場・需要調査
・競合サイトの自然検索の流入キーワード分析
・EC（Amazon・楽天）の商品リサーチ

日本の検索市場データに強みがあり、月間検索数の調査では海外の地域・言語の指定にも対応しています。利用にはラッコキーワードのアカウントが必要です。
